dialogues.jp: 「ふあ〜。やっと終わった」
dialogues.en: "Whew... it's finally over."
dialogues.text: "Whew... it's finally over."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生の、付属での最後の言葉を聞き、卒業式
が終わり、教室へと帰ってきた。
dialogues.en:
The graduation ceremony ended with Koyomi-sensei's final
words to our class, and we headed back to the classroom.
dialogues.text:
The graduation ceremony ended with Koyomi-sensei's final
words to our class, and we headed back to the classroom.

dialogues.jp:
先生の言葉も、卒業式らしく、もっとしんみり
するのかと思いきや、
dialogues.en: I thought her speech would be a bit more sappy, but instead,
dialogues.text: I thought her speech would be a bit more sappy, but instead,

dialogues.jp:
『春休み、羽目をはずし過ぎるヤツは、補導さ
れないよう気をつけろ』
dialogues.en:
"Be careful during the spring break, you won't have my
guidance anymore."
dialogues.text:
"Be careful during the spring break, you won't have my
guidance anymore."

dialogues.jp:
って、案外普通だよな。期待してたのに、ちょっ
と拍子抜け。
dialogues.en:
It was just like any other parental advice. It was
disappointing, in a way.
dialogues.text:
It was just like any other parental advice. It was
disappointing, in a way.

dialogues.jp: 感傷という言葉からはほど遠い。
dialogues.en:
Seeing sentimental words come out from her mouth, seems an
even longer distance away now.
dialogues.text:
Seeing sentimental words come out from her mouth, seems an
even longer distance away now.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、｛さすが／流石｝に卒業式での答辞や、歌はくるも
のがある。
dialogues.en:
The emotional factor wasn't completely neglected at the
graduation ceremony though, thanks to the songs sung.
dialogues.text:
The emotional factor wasn't completely neglected at the
graduation ceremony though, thanks to the songs sung.

dialogues.jp:
『仰げば尊し』も、『蛍の光』も、それなりに
感傷的な気持ちになれた。
dialogues.en:
"Look Up and Ahead", "Light of the Firefly", such songs were
perfect in stirring up emotions in a fragile heart.
dialogues.text:
"Look Up and Ahead", "Light of the Firefly", such songs were
perfect in stirring up emotions in a fragile heart.

dialogues.jp: ま、半分は式の雰囲気によるものだろうが……。
dialogues.en:
Although half of the feelings could be attributed to the
occasion too...
dialogues.text:
Although half of the feelings could be attributed to the
occasion too...

dialogues.jp: 付属の生活も、結構良かった。
dialogues.en: Life in this school was good.
dialogues.text: Life in this school was good.

dialogues.jp:
まあ４月からもほとんど変わらないんだろうけ
ど。
dialogues.en: Not like much would change once April rolls around, though.
dialogues.text: Not like much would change once April rolls around, though.

dialogues.jp: 俺は大きく伸びをした後に、環の方を見る。
dialogues.en:
I gave myself a good stretch from the long ceremony, and
took a glance in Tamaki's direction.
dialogues.text:
I gave myself a good stretch from the long ceremony, and
took a glance in Tamaki's direction.

dialogues.jp:
環は、俺と目が合うと、慌てて目を反らす。は
にかんだ顔が、なんとなく可愛い。
dialogues.en:
I caught her staring at me, causing her to quickly look
away. Even her shy reaction was somehow cute.
dialogues.text:
I caught her staring at me, causing her to quickly look
away. Even her shy reaction was somehow cute.

dialogues.jp: やっぱ、誘うなら俺からだよな。
dialogues.en: Looks like it has to be me to make the first move.
dialogues.text: Looks like it has to be me to make the first move.

dialogues.jp: 俺は立ち上がり、環の席へと移動する。
dialogues.en: I stood up, and went forward to Tamaki's desk.
dialogues.text: I stood up, and went forward to Tamaki's desk.

dialogues.jp: 「どう？　行けそう？」
dialogues.en: "Well? Shall we go?"
dialogues.text: "Well? Shall we go?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「は、はい」
dialogues.en: "Ah, y, yes!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, y, yes!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、行くか」
dialogues.en: "Then, let's."
dialogues.text: "Then, let's."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
二度目の『はい』は、気持ちのいい笑みと一緒
だった。
dialogues.en:
With her second "yes", she flashed a feel-good smile and
stood up as well.
dialogues.text:
With her second "yes", she flashed a feel-good smile and
stood up as well.

dialogues.jp: これから、卒業パーティーだ。
dialogues.en: So this is the graduation party...
dialogues.text: So this is the graduation party...

dialogues.jp: 「さてと、何から回ろうか？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm... where do you want to look around?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm... where do you want to look around?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は辺りを見ながら、環を窺う。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki and I observed the hustle and bustle of activity
around us.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki and I observed the hustle and bustle of activity
around us.

dialogues.jp:
環は俺の横を遅れないように歩きながら、物珍
しそうに周りを見回していた。
dialogues.en:
She never failed to walk exactly in step with me, as she
looked around curiously.
dialogues.text:
She never failed to walk exactly in step with me, as she
looked around curiously.

dialogues.jp: 「環、何か見たいものある？」
dialogues.en: "Was there something you wanted to see?"
dialogues.text: "Was there something you wanted to see?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「うーん……」

環は、風紀委員が作成したパンフレットをじっ
と見つめる。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki opened, and looked at the pamphlet distributed by the
Discplinary Committee.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki opened, and looked at the pamphlet distributed by the
Discplinary Committee.

dialogues.jp:
今年はどうだろう？　あまりめぼしい物は無い
のかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
I wonder what stuff there is this year? Maybe she has some
objective?
dialogues.text:
I wonder what stuff there is this year? Maybe she has some
objective?

dialogues.jp: 環は、思い出したようにポンッと手を打ち、
dialogues.en:
Suddenly, remembering something, Tamaki clapped her hands
together.
dialogues.text:
Suddenly, remembering something, Tamaki clapped her hands
together.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「この間、朝倉様が言っていたメイド喫茶とい
　うのは……」
dialogues.en:
"A few days ago, Asakura-sama mentioned something about a
maid cafe..."
dialogues.text:
"A few days ago, Asakura-sama mentioned something about a
maid cafe..."

dialogues.jp: と無邪気な顔で環は俺に質問する。
dialogues.en:
Her face displayed her complete innocence as she talked to
me.
dialogues.text:
Her face displayed her complete innocence as she talked to
me.

dialogues.jp: うーん。そうきたか。
dialogues.en: Hoo boy, here it comes.
dialogues.text: Hoo boy, here it comes.

dialogues.jp: この間挙げた、例えが悪かったんだな。
dialogues.en: If I let this just pass by, I may regret it later.
dialogues.text: If I let this just pass by, I may regret it later.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、言葉に詰まる。
dialogues.en: I made it short and sweet.
dialogues.text: I made it short and sweet.

dialogues.jp: 「うん……。ま、あまり面白くなさそうだしな」
dialogues.en: "Well... I don't think it'd be interesting for you."
dialogues.text: "Well... I don't think it'd be interesting for you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え？　そうなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? You think so?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh? You think so?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「多分、女の子にはね」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, you're a girl, after all."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, you're a girl, after all."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、他のところを考えないと……」
dialogues.en: "If that's the case, I can't think of anything else..."
dialogues.text: "If that's the case, I can't think of anything else..."

dialogues.jp: 環はまだ考え込んでいる。
dialogues.en: She fell into deep thought again.
dialogues.text: She fell into deep thought again.

dialogues.jp:
いっそ、メイド喫茶に連れて行ってやった方が、
環もすっきりするのだろうか？
dialogues.en:
Actually, maybe going to that maid cafe would refresh us a
little?
dialogues.text:
Actually, maybe going to that maid cafe would refresh us a
little?

dialogues.jp:
女の子は、メイドに給仕されると、どんな気分
になるのだろう？
dialogues.en:
I wonder, what would she feel, being served by another girl
in a maid outfit?
dialogues.text:
I wonder, what would she feel, being served by another girl
in a maid outfit?

dialogues.jp:
案外普通に対応できるものなのか？　男が感じ
るような萌えは多分ないんだろうが。
dialogues.en:
I doubt she'd get all "cuteeee~" like us guys... would she
think it's normal?
dialogues.text:
I doubt she'd get all "cuteeee~" like us guys... would she
think it's normal?

dialogues.jp:
しかし、カップルで入ると確実に浮くような気
がする。というか、居心地悪いだろうな。
dialogues.en:
On top of that, it's a maid cafe... it would be weird to go
to one of those things as a couple.
dialogues.text:
On top of that, it's a maid cafe... it would be weird to go
to one of those things as a couple.

dialogues.jp: 注目を浴びるのは、あまり嬉しくない。
dialogues.en:
She won't be very happy at the amount of "reconaissance" I
would be doing.
dialogues.text:
She won't be very happy at the amount of "reconaissance" I
would be doing.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あっ、朝倉様、これ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Asakura-sama!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, Asakura-sama!"

dialogues.jp:
考えながら歩いていると、不意に環の声で呼び
止められた。
dialogues.en:
I was walking blindly while thinking, and Tamaki's voice
brought me back from my thoughts.
dialogues.text:
I was walking blindly while thinking, and Tamaki's voice
brought me back from my thoughts.

dialogues.jp:
振り返ると、環は掲示板に張ってある張り紙に
目を凝らしている。
dialogues.en:
I turned around. Tamaki was looking at a notice on one of
the bulletin boards we had passed by.
dialogues.text:
I turned around. Tamaki was looking at a notice on one of
the bulletin boards we had passed by.

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうした？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What's that?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What's that?"

dialogues.jp: 俺も環の横に並ぶ。
dialogues.en: I backtracked and stood at her side.
dialogues.text: I backtracked and stood at her side.

dialogues.jp: 見ると、お汁粉大会の張り紙がしてある。
dialogues.en:
It was an advertisement for a sweet red-bean soup drinking
tournament.
dialogues.text:
It was an advertisement for a sweet red-bean soup drinking
tournament.

dialogues.jp:
「へえ。優勝者にはドズニーリゾート、ネズミ
　と戯れる旅か……」
dialogues.en:
"Huh. The winner gets to go to a Dosney Resort, frolicking
with mice..."
dialogues.text:
"Huh. The winner gets to go to a Dosney Resort, frolicking
with mice..."

dialogues.jp: しかも、２枚。
dialogues.en: Moreover, it's a trip for 2.
dialogues.text: Moreover, it's a trip for 2.

dialogues.jp: カップルで行けてしまう。
dialogues.en: Meant for couples, obviously.
dialogues.text: Meant for couples, obviously.

dialogues.jp:
最近の賞品は豪華になったもんだ。ネズミと戯
れる旅というコピーは疑問だが。
dialogues.en:
The prizes for these contests sure are getting bigger and
bigger.
dialogues.text:
The prizes for these contests sure are getting bigger and
bigger.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様、参加してみませんか？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama, shall we participate?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama, shall we participate?"

dialogues.jp:
お、珍しい。環の方から積極的に誘ってくるな
んて。
dialogues.en: Wow, her taking proactive action is rare.
dialogues.text: Wow, her taking proactive action is rare.

dialogues.jp:
「無理無理。こういうのは大食いのやつらばか
　り集まるから、勝ち目ないよ」
dialogues.en:
"Haha, no way. This kind of contest would attract those
weirdos who actually practice for it. We can't win."
dialogues.text:
"Haha, no way. This kind of contest would attract those
weirdos who actually practice for it. We can't win."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そんなのやってみなくちゃわかりませんよ」
dialogues.en: "We'd never know for sure, until we try."
dialogues.text: "We'd never know for sure, until we try."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「いくら環が和菓子好きでも、そんな細い身体
　じゃなあ……」
dialogues.en: "I know you like sweets, but with that kind of body..."
dialogues.text: "I know you like sweets, but with that kind of body..."

dialogues.jp: お汁粉が体に入りきらないだろう。
dialogues.en: It doesn't look like she could take that much.
dialogues.text: It doesn't look like she could take that much.

dialogues.jp: 良くて２杯でギブアップだ。
dialogues.en: Maybe 2 cups before she gives up...
dialogues.text: Maybe 2 cups before she gives up...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、試しに勝負しましょう」
dialogues.en: "Then, let's have a little competition between us."
dialogues.text: "Then, let's have a little competition between us."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp:
てっきり、諦めるかと思いきや、環は人生の挑
戦を吹っかけてくる。
dialogues.en:
I thought that would discourage her, but it only seemed to
provoke her fighting spirit.
dialogues.text:
I thought that would discourage her, but it only seemed to
provoke her fighting spirit.

dialogues.jp:
なんでだ？　環の過去には、お汁粉との深い因
縁でも？
dialogues.en:
This is... odd. Was she irrevocably linked to sweet red-bean
drinks for years or something?
dialogues.text:
This is... odd. Was she irrevocably linked to sweet red-bean
drinks for years or something?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わたくしが勝ったら、デートしてください」
dialogues.en: "If I win, we shall go on a date."
dialogues.text: "If I win, we shall go on a date."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehhh!?"
dialogues.text: "Ehhh!?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は、唐突な環の提案に驚く。
dialogues.en: I was taken back at Tamaki's sudden propsal.
dialogues.text: I was taken back at Tamaki's sudden propsal.

dialogues.jp: 珍しく、今日の環は大胆だ。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's awfully gutsy today...
dialogues.text: Tamaki's awfully gutsy today...

dialogues.jp:
しかし、お汁粉とデート、一体どういう関係が
あるんだ？
dialogues.en: How did we go from sweet red-bean drinks to dates, though?
dialogues.text: How did we go from sweet red-bean drinks to dates, though?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……いやですか？」
dialogues.en: "...You don't want to?"
dialogues.text: "...You don't want to?"

dialogues.jp: 環は上目遣いで俺を見る。
dialogues.en: Tamaki looked at me from below, with puppy-dog eyes.
dialogues.text: Tamaki looked at me from below, with puppy-dog eyes.

dialogues.jp:
そんな目をされると、正直弱い。雰囲気的に、
断れなくなってしまう。
dialogues.en:
With those kind of eyes staring at me, there's no way I
could refuse...
dialogues.text:
With those kind of eyes staring at me, there's no way I
could refuse...

dialogues.jp: 「嫌じゃないけど……」
dialogues.en: "It's not that I don't want to..."
dialogues.text: "It's not that I don't want to..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、決まりですね」
dialogues.en: "Then it's fine."
dialogues.text: "Then it's fine."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「会場に向かいましょう」
dialogues.en: "Let's go to the registration counter."
dialogues.text: "Let's go to the registration counter."

dialogues.jp: 環は、喜々として歩き出す。
dialogues.en: Tamaki happily walked off.
dialogues.text: Tamaki happily walked off.

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待て、俺が勝ったときの条件は？」
dialogues.en: "Hold it! What about if I win?"
dialogues.text: "Hold it! What about if I win?"

dialogues.jp:
別に提案しなくてもよかったのだが、勝負はこ
の方が盛り上がるだろう。
dialogues.en:
If I'm being forced into this, I might as well try to get
something out of it.
dialogues.text:
If I'm being forced into this, I might as well try to get
something out of it.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、そうですね。何がいいですか？」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, that's right. What would you like?"
dialogues.text: "Ahh, that's right. What would you like?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そうだなあ……。焼きそばパン一週間分おご
　るってのはどう？」
dialogues.en: "Hm... how about a week's supply of yakisoba bread?"
dialogues.text: "Hm... how about a week's supply of yakisoba bread?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いいですよ。やりましょう」
dialogues.en: "I accept."
dialogues.text: "I accept."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よし、じゃ、会場へ行くぞ」
dialogues.en: "Alright! Let's go to register."
dialogues.text: "Alright! Let's go to register."

dialogues.jp: 俺と環は、勇んで歩き出した。
dialogues.en:
We both walked to the registration counter, wtih a skip in
our step.
dialogues.text:
We both walked to the registration counter, wtih a skip in
our step.

dialogues.jp:
会場へ行くと、やはり恰幅のいい学生達が、す
でにウォーミングアップを始めている。
dialogues.en:
Expectedly, there were plenty of well-built students there,
and the warming-up sessions had already started.
dialogues.text:
Expectedly, there were plenty of well-built students there,
and the warming-up sessions had already started.

dialogues.jp:
白いクロスの引かれた机の上に、ほかほかのお
汁粉が並べられている。
dialogues.en:
Several cups of steaming-hot sweet red-bean drinks were
lined up in a white cross.
dialogues.text:
Several cups of steaming-hot sweet red-bean drinks were
lined up in a white cross.

dialogues.jp:
その傍らでは、超重量級の男が明らかに無理と
思える腹筋運動を試みつつ、ウォーミングアッ
プの真っ最中だ。
dialogues.en:
Beside us, one rather portly chap was exercising his
abdominal muscles... his warming-up, perhaps?
dialogues.text:
Beside us, one rather portly chap was exercising his
abdominal muscles... his warming-up, perhaps?

dialogues.jp:
やはり、一見してその道の『つわもの』が揃っ
ているようだ。
dialogues.en:
Wherever I looked, I was greeted by the sight of warriors
ready to do battle.
dialogues.text:
Wherever I looked, I was greeted by the sight of warriors
ready to do battle.

dialogues.jp:
ま、とりあえず今回は、俺と環の勝負だからな。
周りのことはあまり考えなくてもよさそうだ。
dialogues.en:
Oh well... this is a battle between Tamaki and myself. I
don't need to think too much about the others.
dialogues.text:
Oh well... this is a battle between Tamaki and myself. I
don't need to think too much about the others.

dialogues.speaker: Male Student 1
dialogues.jp:
「では、大会に出場するかたは、エントリーシー
　トをご記入ください」
dialogues.en:
"Attention all, if you wish to participate, please submit
your entry forms!"
dialogues.text:
"Attention all, if you wish to participate, please submit
your entry forms!"

dialogues.jp: 俺と環は並んでシートに記入する。
dialogues.en: Tamaki and I went to enter our forms, side-by-side.
dialogues.text: Tamaki and I went to enter our forms, side-by-side.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「今回は負けませんよ」
dialogues.en: "I will not lose this round."
dialogues.text: "I will not lose this round."

dialogues.jp: 書き終えた後、環が挑発してくる。
dialogues.en: As she finished writing, she layed out her resolve.
dialogues.text: As she finished writing, she layed out her resolve.

dialogues.jp: 「望むところだ」
dialogues.en: "We shall see."
dialogues.text: "We shall see."

dialogues.jp:
と、発言はしてみるものの……。なんだか、勝
負という緊迫感が自分にない。
dialogues.en:
Honestly though... it's not like there's any pressure on me
to win this battle.
dialogues.text:
Honestly though... it's not like there's any pressure on me
to win this battle.

dialogues.jp:
別に負けてしまっても、自分にとってなんら不
利益ではない。
dialogues.en:
Even if I lose, I'm not exactly getting the short end of the
stick.
dialogues.text:
Even if I lose, I'm not exactly getting the short end of the
stick.

dialogues.jp:
勝てば焼きそばパン、負ければ環とデート。む
しろ、勝とうか負けようか悩むくらいだ。
dialogues.en:
Yakisoba bread if I win, a date with Tamaki if I lose. I
actually have to think about which I want...
dialogues.text:
Yakisoba bread if I win, a date with Tamaki if I lose. I
actually have to think about which I want...

dialogues.jp:
デートなんて、別に無理に勝負で決めることも
無い気がするのだが、環にとっては、それがい
いんだろうな。
dialogues.en:
Deciding whether to go on a date through a battle though...
well, if Tamaki's fine with it...
dialogues.text:
Deciding whether to go on a date through a battle though...
well, if Tamaki's fine with it...

dialogues.speaker: Male Student 1
dialogues.jp: 「では、始めます」
dialogues.en: "The competion begins now!"
dialogues.text: "The competion begins now!"

dialogues.jp:
横並びで座っている挑戦者達は、一斉にお汁粉
の｛ふた／蓋｝を開ける。
dialogues.en:
The herd of contestants, sitting in a row, all opened their
covered cups at once.
dialogues.text:
The herd of contestants, sitting in a row, all opened their
covered cups at once.

dialogues.jp: うわっ、餅二つかよ。
dialogues.en: Wooow, two mochis inside?
dialogues.text: Wooow, two mochis inside?

dialogues.jp:
餅が入っているのと無いのとでは、早く食べる
速度にかなり影響が出る。
dialogues.en:
If I drink it too quickly, it'd have a bad effect on my
endurance...
dialogues.text:
If I drink it too quickly, it'd have a bad effect on my
endurance...

dialogues.jp: 何と言っても、環は女の子だからな。
dialogues.en: And no matter how you cut it, Tamaki's still a girl.
dialogues.text: And no matter how you cut it, Tamaki's still a girl.

dialogues.jp:
なかなか食らいつく、という訳にも行かないだ
ろう。
dialogues.en: She can't have that much tolerance for things like this.
dialogues.text: She can't have that much tolerance for things like this.

dialogues.jp: この勝負、勝つべきか負けるべきか……。
dialogues.en: The line between victory and defeat is sharp here...
dialogues.text: The line between victory and defeat is sharp here...

dialogues.jp: 食べながら、ちらりと環の方を見る。
dialogues.en: As I drank, I stole a glance in Tamaki's direction.
dialogues.text: As I drank, I stole a glance in Tamaki's direction.

dialogues.jp:
相変わらず｛みやび／雅｝な手つきで、上品にお汁粉を食べ
ている。
dialogues.en:
She was drinking out of her cup with the elegance you'd
expect from her.
dialogues.text:
She was drinking out of her cup with the elegance you'd
expect from her.

dialogues.jp: あの食べ方では、ギブアップは時間の問題だな。
dialogues.en: At that speed, giving up is only a matter of time...
dialogues.text: At that speed, giving up is only a matter of time...

dialogues.jp: やっぱ、焼きそばパンは魅力的だよな。
dialogues.en:
...Those yakisoba bread are starting to look more and more
attractive...
dialogues.text:
...Those yakisoba bread are starting to look more and more
attractive...

dialogues.jp: 俺は速度を早めてお汁粉を食べ始めた。
dialogues.en: I started to speed up my drinking.
dialogues.text: I started to speed up my drinking.

dialogues.jp:
そういえば今日、美少女コンテストもやるんだ
よな。誰が出るんだろう？
dialogues.en:
Oh yeah, isn't the beauty contest today? I wonder who's
taking part?
dialogues.text:
Oh yeah, isn't the beauty contest today? I wonder who's
taking part?

dialogues.jp:
やはり、見所は学園アイドルの白河ことりなん
だろうか？
dialogues.en:
Perhaps Shirakawa Kotori, the school idol? If she does,
she'd be the highlight for sure.
dialogues.text:
Perhaps Shirakawa Kotori, the school idol? If she does,
she'd be the highlight for sure.

dialogues.jp:
なんてことを考えてたのがいけなかったか。そ
ろそろ苦しくなってきたぞ。
dialogues.en:
I tried to fill my mind with thoughts like that to keep my
mind away from the feelings swelling in my mouth.
dialogues.text:
I tried to fill my mind with thoughts like that to keep my
mind away from the feelings swelling in my mouth.

dialogues.jp:
４杯目を食べ終えた後、急に苦しさがこみ上げ
てくる。
dialogues.en:
By the fourth cup, the pain was getting exponentially
higher.
dialogues.text:
By the fourth cup, the pain was getting exponentially
higher.

dialogues.jp: 流石に５杯目は限界か……。
dialogues.en: Five cups is going to be my limit...
dialogues.text: Five cups is going to be my limit...

dialogues.jp: 俺は、ちらりと環を見る。
dialogues.en: I glaced at Tamaki again.
dialogues.text: I glaced at Tamaki again.

dialogues.jp:
先ほどと変わらず、雅に食べてはいるが、５杯
目に突入している。
dialogues.en:
Just as before, she was elegantly drinking what was her
fifth cup.
dialogues.text:
Just as before, she was elegantly drinking what was her
fifth cup.

dialogues.jp:
げっ。顔色一つ変わってない……。しかも、俺、
負けてるじゃん。
dialogues.en:
Gah... her reaction hasn't changed one bit... I'm going to
lose.
dialogues.text:
Gah... her reaction hasn't changed one bit... I'm going to
lose.

dialogues.jp: もう結構きてるんだが……。
dialogues.en: I've done my best...
dialogues.text: I've done my best...

dialogues.jp: どうしよう。
dialogues.en: What should I do...
dialogues.text: What should I do...

dialogues.jp: これ以上食うと、流石にやばいかもな……。
dialogues.en: If I keep on going, I'd be putting myself in danger...
dialogues.text: If I keep on going, I'd be putting myself in danger...

dialogues.jp: ここは、負けておくか？
dialogues.en: Should I just admit defeat?
dialogues.text: Should I just admit defeat?

dialogues.jp: 負けても、環とのデートだしな。
dialogues.en: If I lose, I'd go on a date with Tamaki...
dialogues.text: If I lose, I'd go on a date with Tamaki...

dialogues.jp:
と、思ったとき、環がいきなり箸をおいて立ち
上がる。
dialogues.en:
But, before I could think about it too deeply, Tamaki
suddenly stood up.
dialogues.text:
But, before I could think about it too deeply, Tamaki
suddenly stood up.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様！」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama!"

dialogues.jp: 隣に座っている俺にいきなり話しかける。
dialogues.en: She called out to me, just one seat away, in a strong voice.
dialogues.text: She called out to me, just one seat away, in a strong voice.

dialogues.jp: 俺はびっくりして、餅を喉に詰まらせてしまう。
dialogues.en:
The abruptness caused a piece of the mochi to get stuck in
my throat.
dialogues.text:
The abruptness caused a piece of the mochi to get stuck in
my throat.

dialogues.jp:
急いで机の上にあるお茶をがぶ飲みする。餅を
喉に詰まらせて死亡。そんな末代までのネタに
なるような死に方はしたくない。
dialogues.en:
I quickly reached for a cup of tea and swallowed it down.
The last thing I'd want is to die here...
dialogues.text:
I quickly reached for a cup of tea and swallowed it down.
The last thing I'd want is to die here...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの、白河さんが……」
dialogues.en: "S, Shirakawa-san is..."
dialogues.text: "S, Shirakawa-san is..."

dialogues.jp: 環は、完全に食べるのをやめている。
dialogues.en: Tamaki had completely stopped drinking.
dialogues.text: Tamaki had completely stopped drinking.

dialogues.en: "Hah? What?"
dialogues.text: "Hah? What?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は訳が分からず呆然とする。
dialogues.en: I replied, completely dumbfounded.
dialogues.text: I replied, completely dumbfounded.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あー。どうしよう！！」
dialogues.en: "Ahhh, what should I do!!"
dialogues.text: "Ahhh, what should I do!!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり、わたくしの足では時間がないわ」
dialogues.en: "I won't be able to make it there in time..."
dialogues.text: "I won't be able to make it there in time..."

dialogues.jp: 環は独り言を言っている。
dialogues.en: She was babbling to herself.
dialogues.text: She was babbling to herself.

dialogues.jp: しかも、相当、切羽詰っているみたいだ。
dialogues.en:
But she definitely seemed like she was backed against a
wall...
dialogues.text:
But she definitely seemed like she was backed against a
wall...

dialogues.jp: 「え？　環、どうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? Tamaki, what's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh? Tamaki, what's wrong?"

dialogues.jp: 訳が分からないまま、俺も箸を止める。
dialogues.en:
I'd stopped caring about the competition as well, after
seeing her reaction.
dialogues.text:
I'd stopped caring about the competition as well, after
seeing her reaction.

dialogues.jp: 環、俺の顔を見て真剣な表情になる。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki looked at me, with the seriousness of the world in
her face.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki looked at me, with the seriousness of the world in
her face.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉様。今から体育館まで全速力で走って、
　ステージに上ってください」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura-sama. You must run to the gym with all your
strength, and get onto the stage, at once."
dialogues.text:
"Asakura-sama. You must run to the gym with all your
strength, and get onto the stage, at once."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ステージ？」
dialogues.en: "The stage?"
dialogues.text: "The stage?"

dialogues.jp: って、今、美少女コンテストやってるよな。
dialogues.en: Isn't the beauty contest happening there right now?
dialogues.text: Isn't the beauty contest happening there right now?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「多分、白河さんが舞台にいますから、そのま
　ま押し倒してください」
dialogues.en:
"Shirakawa-san will be on the stage at that time... please
push her down."
dialogues.text:
"Shirakawa-san will be on the stage at that time... please
push her down."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「は？　押し倒す？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Push her down?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Push her down?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いいから早く！」
dialogues.en: "Hurry!"
dialogues.text: "Hurry!"

dialogues.jp: 環は、俺の手をひっぱり、会場を抜け出す。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki grabbed my hand, and rushed out of the competition
area.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki grabbed my hand, and rushed out of the competition
area.

dialogues.jp:
会場の外に出た俺は、環に言われたとおり、全
速力で走り出す。
dialogues.en:
Once we exited, following what Tamaki said, I ran as fast as
I could, to the gym.
dialogues.text:
Once we exited, following what Tamaki said, I ran as fast as
I could, to the gym.

dialogues.jp:
ふと、後ろを振り返ると、環が走りながら制服
を脱ぎ捨て、巫女装束姿になっている。
dialogues.en:
I checked behind me, and suddenly noticed that Tamaki had
thrown off her uniform, revealing her Miko costume
underneath.
dialogues.text:
I checked behind me, and suddenly noticed that Tamaki had
thrown off her uniform, revealing her Miko costume
underneath.

dialogues.jp: 環が巫女装束……？　それってつまり……。
dialogues.en: Her Miko costume... that must mean...
dialogues.text: Her Miko costume... that must mean...

dialogues.jp: ことりの身に、何か起こるのか？
dialogues.en: What's... going to happen to Kotori?
dialogues.text: What's... going to happen to Kotori?

dialogues.jp:
俺は急いでドアを開けると、舞台の方に駆け出
して行く。
dialogues.en: I hurriedly opened the door to the gym, and rushed inside.
dialogues.text: I hurriedly opened the door to the gym, and rushed inside.

dialogues.jp:
舞台の上では、ちょうどことりが、ドレスを着
てインタビューを受けていた。
dialogues.en:
Just as predicted, on the stage was Kotori, all dolled up in
a dress and being interviewed.
dialogues.text:
Just as predicted, on the stage was Kotori, all dolled up in
a dress and being interviewed.

dialogues.jp: 俺はそのまま壇上に駆け上がる。
dialogues.en: Without thinking, I ran for the stage.
dialogues.text: Without thinking, I ran for the stage.

dialogues.jp: 「どけー！！」
dialogues.en: "Move!!"
dialogues.text: "Move!!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は暴れ馬のごとく、舞台の上になだれ込む。
dialogues.en: Like a stampeding horse, I carved a path towards the stage.
dialogues.text: Like a stampeding horse, I carved a path towards the stage.

dialogues.jp:
俺の剣幕に驚き、インタビューしていた司会者
はすかさず道を空ける。
dialogues.en:
Sensing my intent, even the inteviewer quickly stood aside
in shock.
dialogues.text:
Sensing my intent, even the inteviewer quickly stood aside
in shock.

dialogues.jp: 「ことり、すまん」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, Kotori!"
dialogues.text: "Sorry, Kotori!"

dialogues.jp:
と、言いながら、俺はことりの体に覆いかぶさ
るように抱きつき、押し倒す。
dialogues.en:
Hoping my words were enough, I pushed Kotori to the floor,
and covered her with my body.
dialogues.text:
Hoping my words were enough, I pushed Kotori to the floor,
and covered her with my body.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉君？！」
dialogues.en: "A, Asakura-kun?!"
dialogues.text: "A, Asakura-kun?!"

dialogues.jp: ことりは目を白黒させている。
dialogues.en: Kotori's eyes were filled with sheer surprise.
dialogues.text: Kotori's eyes were filled with sheer surprise.

dialogues.jp:
場内の観客から「おおー！」とか、「何だあれ」
と一斉にどよめく。
dialogues.en:
The spectators were immediately put into disarray, wondering
what on earth was going on.
dialogues.text:
The spectators were immediately put into disarray, wondering
what on earth was going on.

dialogues.jp: それと同時に。
dialogues.en: At that moment,
dialogues.text: At that moment,

dialogues.jp: ──ガコン！
dialogues.en: --*crack*?I
dialogues.text: --*crack*?I

dialogues.jp: 頭上で何かが外れる音がした！
dialogues.en:
I heard the sound of something breaking, right above my
head.
dialogues.text:
I heard the sound of something breaking, right above my
head.

dialogues.jp: 「やばい！」
dialogues.en: "Damn!"
dialogues.text: "Damn!"

dialogues.jp: 俺はことりを庇うように、ことりの上に乗る。
dialogues.en: I steadied my balance over Kotori, and braced myself.
dialogues.text: I steadied my balance over Kotori, and braced myself.

dialogues.jp:
冷静に考えると、かなり怪しい体勢だが、今は
そんなことは言ってられない。
dialogues.en:
Thinking about it calmly, I was in a rather incriminating
position, but I decided not to say anything about it.
dialogues.text:
Thinking about it calmly, I was in a rather incriminating
position, but I decided not to say anything about it.

dialogues.jp: カキーン！
dialogues.en: *sching!*
dialogues.text: *sching!*

dialogues.jp: 鋭い金属音。
dialogues.en: The sound of sharp metal piercing something.
dialogues.text: The sound of sharp metal piercing something.

dialogues.jp: 俺は思わず上を見る。
dialogues.en: I instinctively looked upwards.
dialogues.text: I instinctively looked upwards.

dialogues.jp: すると、矢のような物が頭上を｛かす／掠｝めてゆく。
dialogues.en:
Apparently, an arrow-like object had flew just above, and
past, my head.
dialogues.text:
Apparently, an arrow-like object had flew just above, and
past, my head.

dialogues.jp: ……神様、俺が悪うございました。
dialogues.en: ...God, forgive me for my sins.
dialogues.text: ...God, forgive me for my sins.

dialogues.jp:
ちょっとことりの体を、柔らかいと思ってしま
いました。
dialogues.en: I have thought such sinful thoughts of such a pure body...
dialogues.text: I have thought such sinful thoughts of such a pure body...

dialogues.jp: どうか、どうか命だけは……。
dialogues.en: My life might not be enough...
dialogues.text: My life might not be enough...

dialogues.jp: 取られてないみたいだ。
dialogues.en: ...I guess it's all over.
dialogues.text: ...I guess it's all over.

dialogues.jp: 体育館から音が無くなり、俺はふと顔を上げる。
dialogues.en:
The deafening silence eventually encouraged me to lift my
head.
dialogues.text:
The deafening silence eventually encouraged me to lift my
head.

dialogues.jp:
すると、体育館の入り口に、環が巫女装束で、
弓を持って立っている。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki, still clad in her miko-costume, caught my attention.
She was standing at the entrance, holding a bow.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki, still clad in her miko-costume, caught my attention.
She was standing at the entrance, holding a bow.

dialogues.jp: その姿は、美しいまでに｛りん／凛｝としている。
dialogues.en: That appearance, so beautiful, yet so distant...
dialogues.text: That appearance, so beautiful, yet so distant...

dialogues.jp:
ステージを見ると、落ちて曲がったスポットラ
イトの残骸と、その隣に矢が落ちている。
dialogues.en:
Looking around the stage, I spotted a wrecked spotlight. It
was pierced at one side by an arrow.
dialogues.text:
Looking around the stage, I spotted a wrecked spotlight. It
was pierced at one side by an arrow.

dialogues.jp: と、いうことは、
dialogues.en: In other words,
dialogues.text: In other words,

dialogues.jp:
環が落ちてくるスポットライトを、矢で弾いて
くれたんだ。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki changed the course of the falling spotlight, by
knocking it away with her arrow shot.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki changed the course of the falling spotlight, by
knocking it away with her arrow shot.

dialogues.jp: 「危なかった……」
dialogues.en: "That... was dangerous."
dialogues.text: "That... was dangerous."

dialogues.jp: 俺は安堵のため息をついた。
dialogues.en: I breathed a huge sigh of relief.
dialogues.text: I breathed a huge sigh of relief.

dialogues.jp: 腕の中のことりを見ると、呆然としている。
dialogues.en: Kotori, still bound by my arms, was completely dumbfounded.
dialogues.text: Kotori, still bound by my arms, was completely dumbfounded.

dialogues.jp:
「ふー。間に合ってよかった。ことり、怪我は
　ないか？」
dialogues.en: "Whew... it was just in time. Kotori, are you injured?"
dialogues.text: "Whew... it was just in time. Kotori, are you injured?"

dialogues.jp:
ステージの下を見ると、誰もが何が起こったか
把握できておらず、水を打ったように静まり返っ
ている。
dialogues.en:
I looked below the stage, at the wave of onlookers trying to
comprehend what they just saw. It was so silent.
dialogues.text:
I looked below the stage, at the wave of onlookers trying to
comprehend what they just saw. It was so silent.

dialogues.jp: しかし、次の瞬間。
dialogues.en: Until the next moment,
dialogues.text: Until the next moment,

dialogues.speaker: Male Student 1
dialogues.jp: 「こりゃすごい！　女版ロビンフッドだ！」
dialogues.en: "Amazing! She's a female Robin Hood!"
dialogues.text: "Amazing! She's a female Robin Hood!"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp: 「本当だ！　こいつはすげえ！！」
dialogues.en: "She's the real thing! She's incredible!"
dialogues.text: "She's the real thing! She's incredible!"

dialogues.jp:
一人が口を開いたのをきっかけに、会場の聴衆
たちは、各々口を開き始め、会場は一気にうる
さくなった。
dialogues.en:
What started from one person's mouth, became a cacophany of
sound throughout the entire gym.
dialogues.text:
What started from one person's mouth, became a cacophany of
sound throughout the entire gym.

dialogues.jp:
そして、どこからともなく、環に向かって拍手
が贈られている。
dialogues.en: Soon, the applause began, echoing everywhere.
dialogues.text: Soon, the applause began, echoing everywhere.

dialogues.jp: 環はその拍手に驚き、戸惑っている。
dialogues.en: Tamaki was completely lost at what to do.
dialogues.text: Tamaki was completely lost at what to do.

dialogues.jp:
どうしたらいいのかわからないらしく、｛おび／怯｝えて
いるようにも見える。
dialogues.en: She seemed like a mouse, frightened and timid.
dialogues.text: She seemed like a mouse, frightened and timid.

dialogues.jp: 側に行ってやった方がいいよな……。
dialogues.en: I better go to her side...
dialogues.text: I better go to her side...

dialogues.jp: 俺は、ことりを起こし、埃を払ってやる。
dialogues.en: I got up from over Kotori, and dusted her off.
dialogues.text: I got up from over Kotori, and dusted her off.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ありがとう、朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "T, thank you, Asakura-kun..."
dialogues.text: "T, thank you, Asakura-kun..."

dialogues.jp: 少し落ち着いたのか、ことりは俺に礼を言う。
dialogues.en: Kotori thanked me, seeming to have calmed down a little.
dialogues.text: Kotori thanked me, seeming to have calmed down a little.

dialogues.jp:
「礼なら、環に言ってやってくれ。あいつのお
　陰だからな」
dialogues.en: "Tamaki's the one you should thank."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki's the one you should thank."

dialogues.jp: 俺も自分の制服の埃を払う。
dialogues.en: I then started to dust my own uniform off.
dialogues.text: I then started to dust my own uniform off.

dialogues.jp: 「ことり、ごめん。俺行くわ」
dialogues.en: "Kotori... sorry, I'm going now."
dialogues.text: "Kotori... sorry, I'm going now."

dialogues.jp:
と、悪いとは思ったが、ことりを残して壇上を
降りる。
dialogues.en: I left her on the stage, feeling a little bad for doing so.
dialogues.text: I left her on the stage, feeling a little bad for doing so.

dialogues.jp: そして、急いで環の方へと駆け寄る。
dialogues.en:
But, there was somoene who needed me. I hurried to where
Tamaki was.
dialogues.text:
But, there was somoene who needed me. I hurried to where
Tamaki was.

dialogues.jp:
今にも飛び掛りそうな男子学生たちの中で、環
は縋るような目で俺を見る。
dialogues.en:
Surrounded by a wall of male students, Tamaki's eyes
pleadingly looked in my direction.
dialogues.text:
Surrounded by a wall of male students, Tamaki's eyes
pleadingly looked in my direction.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環の手を取る。
dialogues.en: I took her hand into mine.
dialogues.text: I took her hand into mine.

dialogues.jp: 「環、行くぞ」
dialogues.en: "Tamaki, let's go."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki, let's go."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい！」
dialogues.en: "O, okay!"
dialogues.text: "O, okay!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は環を連れて、喧騒さめやらぬ体育館を飛び
出す。映画のワンシーンみたいに。
dialogues.en:
I accompanied her out of the still-tumultous gymnasium, like
a scene from a movie.
dialogues.text:
I accompanied her out of the still-tumultous gymnasium, like
a scene from a movie.

dialogues.jp:
耳には、二人を呼び止めようとするみんなの声
が聞こえていたが……。
dialogues.en:
The baying of the crowd, wanting us to come back, reached my
ears...
dialogues.text:
The baying of the crowd, wanting us to come back, reached my
ears...

dialogues.jp:
俺の意識は、今握りしめている女ロビンフッド
の手の温かさに向けられていた……。
dialogues.en:
With the sensation of Robin Hood's hand flowing through my
own...
dialogues.text:
With the sensation of Robin Hood's hand flowing through my
own...

dialogues.jp: 俺と環は、全速力で走り、屋上に着いた。
dialogues.en: Tamaki and I ran off, for the rooftop, at full speed.
dialogues.text: Tamaki and I ran off, for the rooftop, at full speed.

dialogues.jp: 二人とも、息を切らせて、フェンスにもたれる。
dialogues.en:
Out of breath, we stopped and held on to a fence to support
ourselves.
dialogues.text:
Out of breath, we stopped and held on to a fence to support
ourselves.

dialogues.jp: 「ふー。なかなか、かったるかったな」
dialogues.en: "Whew... that was rather... troublesome."
dialogues.text: "Whew... that was rather... troublesome."

dialogues.jp: 俺は環の方を向いて言う。
dialogues.en: I said to no one in particular.
dialogues.text: I said to no one in particular.

dialogues.jp: 環は息を整えながら、俺を見て、微笑んだ。
dialogues.en: Tamaki, catching her breath, simply smiled.
dialogues.text: Tamaki, catching her breath, simply smiled.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、なんだかんだ言って、ことりも助かっ
　たしな。環が教えてくれたお陰だよ」
dialogues.en: "Well, thanks to your "yin", we managed to save Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Well, thanks to your "yin", we managed to save Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そんな、わたくしは別に……」
dialogues.en: "No, I really didn't do anything..."
dialogues.text: "No, I really didn't do anything..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「環のおかげだよ」
dialogues.en: "It's all due to you, Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "It's all due to you, Tamaki."

dialogues.jp:
環はちょっと照れたように頬を染めた。そんな
仕草がなんか可愛い。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's cheeks slowly started to redden. It was so cute...
dialogues.text: Tamaki's cheeks slowly started to redden. It was so cute...

dialogues.jp:
学園のアイドルを救った勇ましいロビンフッド
と、目の前で頬を赤らめる少女。
dialogues.en:
The brave Robin Hood who rescued the school idol... was a
blushing young girl, in front of my eyes.
dialogues.text:
The brave Robin Hood who rescued the school idol... was a
blushing young girl, in front of my eyes.

dialogues.jp: そのどちらもが、環なんだよな。
dialogues.en: It could only be Tamaki.
dialogues.text: It could only be Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 「なんにせよ、よかったよかった」
dialogues.en: "In any case, I'm really glad."
dialogues.text: "In any case, I'm really glad."

dialogues.jp:
人の役に立てるのって、いいよな。どこか、気
持ちが晴れやかになる。
dialogues.en:
Helping out and saving people always leaves a good
aftertaste.
dialogues.text:
Helping out and saving people always leaves a good
aftertaste.

dialogues.jp: 屋上の空気さえ、おいしく感じる。
dialogues.en: The air at the rooftop seemed fresher then before.
dialogues.text: The air at the rooftop seemed fresher then before.

dialogues.jp: たまには人助けも、いいもんだ。
dialogues.en: Being a hero feels nice.
dialogues.text: Being a hero feels nice.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ？　環、どうかした？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Tamaki, are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Tamaki, are you okay?"

dialogues.jp:
俺の充実感とは裏腹に、環の表情が暗いことに
気がつく。
dialogues.en:
Unlike my feelings of contentment, Tamaki's face was clouded
with regret.
dialogues.text:
Unlike my feelings of contentment, Tamaki's face was clouded
with regret.

dialogues.jp: 「俺、変なこと言った？」
dialogues.en: "Did I say something weird?"
dialogues.text: "Did I say something weird?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いいえ……」
環は、何か考えているようである。
dialogues.en: She was thinkin about something.
dialogues.text: She was thinkin about something.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ことりさん、助かってよかった……」
dialogues.en: "I'm glad that we were able to save Shirakawa-san..."
dialogues.text: "I'm glad that we were able to save Shirakawa-san..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様のお陰です」
dialogues.en: "Especially with your help."
dialogues.text: "Especially with your help."

dialogues.jp:
環は俺に笑って見せるが、その表情は曇りを隠
せない。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki returned my smile, but couldn't hide her
expression...
dialogues.text:
Tamaki returned my smile, but couldn't hide her
expression...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「でも？」
dialogues.en: "But?"
dialogues.text: "But?"

dialogues.jp: 何だ？
dialogues.en: What is it?
dialogues.text: What is it?

dialogues.jp:
俺は、また何か、環を理解してあげられてない
のだろうか？
dialogues.en:
Is there even something more that I don't understand about
her?
dialogues.text:
Is there even something more that I don't understand about
her?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「予知能力のことを、みんなに知られてしまい
　ました……」
dialogues.en:
"Now, everyone will know about my clairvoyance for
certain..."
dialogues.text:
"Now, everyone will know about my clairvoyance for
certain..."

dialogues.jp:
あれだけ派手に助ければ、皆に宣伝しているよ
うなものだもんな。
dialogues.en:
With such a flashy rescue, there's no way it won't become
instant publicity material.
dialogues.text:
With such a flashy rescue, there's no way it won't become
instant publicity material.

dialogues.jp: 今までは噂だったものが、真実になってしまう。
dialogues.en: The rumours WILL spread, and the truth will be found out.
dialogues.text: The rumours WILL spread, and the truth will be found out.

dialogues.jp:
確実に、学校内で環は『予知能力者』として認
識されるようになるだろう。
dialogues.en: The whole school will soon realize Tamaki as a "prophet"...
dialogues.text: The whole school will soon realize Tamaki as a "prophet"...

dialogues.jp:
もしかして、環は、前の学校にいた時のように
なることを恐れているのだろうか。
dialogues.en:
In fact, she's probably scared of that due to her
experiences at her previous schools.
dialogues.text:
In fact, she's probably scared of that due to her
experiences at her previous schools.

dialogues.jp: 色々なから、予知能力について聞かれること。
dialogues.en: People learning about her power.
dialogues.text: People learning about her power.

dialogues.jp: 様々な未来を尋ねられること。
dialogues.en: All wanting to ask about their futures.
dialogues.text: All wanting to ask about their futures.

dialogues.jp:
そして、そのためにみんなと一緒にいられなく
なってしまうこと……。
dialogues.en:
So, to keep from that, staying distant from the people she
first meets...
dialogues.text:
So, to keep from that, staying distant from the people she
first meets...

dialogues.jp:
本人しか、その苦しみは分からないのかもしれ
ないが……。
dialogues.en: I can't imagine feeling that kind of pain myself...
dialogues.text: I can't imagine feeling that kind of pain myself...

dialogues.jp:
「変なこと言ってくるヤツがいたら、俺に言え。
　なんとかしてやるから」
dialogues.en:
"If people come up to you and ask weird things, call me. I'd
deal with it, somehow."
dialogues.text:
"If people come up to you and ask weird things, call me. I'd
deal with it, somehow."

dialogues.jp: せめて。
dialogues.en: At the very least,
dialogues.text: At the very least,

dialogues.jp: これぐらいのことは言わせてくれ……。
dialogues.en: I can do this for her...
dialogues.text: I can do this for her...

dialogues.jp:
もちろん、だからと言って環の心の憂いが簡単
に取れるとも思わないが。
dialogues.en:
Of course, this won't be able to lighten her heart by
itself.
dialogues.text:
Of course, this won't be able to lighten her heart by
itself.

dialogues.jp:
｛うち／風見学園｝では、環を変な風に扱うやつは、俺が
許さない。
dialogues.en:
But no matter what, if anyone in school tries to mess with
her, I won't forgive them.
dialogues.text:
But no matter what, if anyone in school tries to mess with
her, I won't forgive them.

dialogues.jp:
環に、前の学校でのことのような、寂しい思い
はさせたくない。
dialogues.en:
I won't let her feel the loneliness and despair from her
last schools, now.
dialogues.text:
I won't let her feel the loneliness and despair from her
last schools, now.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうございます。でも……」
dialogues.en: "Thank you... but..."
dialogues.text: "Thank you... but..."

dialogues.jp: 環の顔は、まだ沈んだままだ。
dialogues.en: She was still as downhearted as before.
dialogues.text: She was still as downhearted as before.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ。まだ何かあるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Is there something else bothering you?"
dialogues.text: "Is there something else bothering you?"

dialogues.jp: 環は、ふっと俺の顔を見る。
dialogues.en: With a deep breath, Tamaki turned to face me.
dialogues.text: With a deep breath, Tamaki turned to face me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「こっちの方が、重大ですよ」
dialogues.en: "That was very important to me."
dialogues.text: "That was very important to me."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「こっち……？　こっちとは？」
dialogues.en: "What... is that?"
dialogues.text: "What... is that?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「本当に、落ち込むんですから」
dialogues.en: "It's really disheartening."
dialogues.text: "It's really disheartening."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「お、落ち込む！？」
dialogues.en: "D, disheartening!?"
dialogues.text: "D, disheartening!?"

dialogues.jp: いったい、なんのことだ？
dialogues.en: Just what is she going on about?
dialogues.text: Just what is she going on about?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Tamaki?"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉様は、女の子の気持ちを読むのが苦手な
　んですね」
dialogues.en:
"You're not very good at reading a girl's feelings, are you,
Asakura-sama?"
dialogues.text:
"You're not very good at reading a girl's feelings, are you,
Asakura-sama?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうかな……」
dialogues.en: "I, I suppose so..."
dialogues.text: "I, I suppose so..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「きっとそこが、朝倉様のいいところでもある
　んでしょうね……」
dialogues.en: "I thought you might be a little better at that..."
dialogues.text: "I thought you might be a little better at that..."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、環は寂しそうに微笑んだ。
dialogues.en: A lonely smile accompanied her words.
dialogues.text: A lonely smile accompanied her words.

dialogues.jp:
やっぱり、俺は何か変なことを言ってしまった
のだろうか。
dialogues.en: I must've said something really odd...
dialogues.text: I must've said something really odd...

dialogues.jp: 「何だよ？　気になるだろ？」
dialogues.en: "What IS it that has you so troubled?"
dialogues.text: "What IS it that has you so troubled?"

dialogues.jp: 環はまた、暗い表情になる。
dialogues.en: Her face still carried a dark expresison.
dialogues.text: Her face still carried a dark expresison.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「……だって……、デートの約束も、無くなっ
　てしまったから……」
dialogues.en: "....The... date... that we promised, is gone..."
dialogues.text: "....The... date... that we promised, is gone..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、もしかして……さっきの？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, you mean... the competition just now?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, you mean... the competition just now?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうです……」
dialogues.en: "Correct..."
dialogues.text: "Correct..."

dialogues.jp:
さっきの騒ぎですっかり抜けてしまっていた。
俺達、デートを賭けて勝負してたんだっけ。
dialogues.en:
In all the excitement, I'd completely fogotten. She
challenged me in order to win a date.
dialogues.text:
In all the excitement, I'd completely fogotten. She
challenged me in order to win a date.

dialogues.jp: 結局勝負はつかなかったわけだ。
dialogues.en: In the end, the battle didn't finish.
dialogues.text: In the end, the battle didn't finish.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、お汁粉大会の様子を振り返ってみる。
dialogues.en: I looked back to see the competition still going strong.
dialogues.text: I looked back to see the competition still going strong.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、あのまま続けていても、俺は５杯目を
食べることはできなかったろうな。
dialogues.en:
Well... if the challenge had continued, I wouldn't have been
able to take more than 5 cups...
dialogues.text:
Well... if the challenge had continued, I wouldn't have been
able to take more than 5 cups...

dialogues.jp: ってことは、俺は負けたってことだよな。
dialogues.en: It really should've been my loss to accept.
dialogues.text: It really should've been my loss to accept.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、勝負はついてた」
dialogues.en: "Nope, the battle was decided."
dialogues.text: "Nope, the battle was decided."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「お汁粉大会は、俺の負けだよ」
dialogues.en: "I lost the sweer red-bean drink competition."
dialogues.text: "I lost the sweer red-bean drink competition."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どうして……」
dialogues.en: "But... why...?"
dialogues.text: "But... why...?"

dialogues.jp: 環は不思議そうな顔をして、俺を見る。
dialogues.en: Tamaki looked at me strangely.
dialogues.text: Tamaki looked at me strangely.

dialogues.jp:
思わず、その瞳に、吸い込まれそうになりなが
らも……。
dialogues.en: I found myself drawn in by those mysterious eyes...
dialogues.text: I found myself drawn in by those mysterious eyes...

dialogues.jp: 「俺は、もうギブアップだったんだよ」
dialogues.en: "I would have given up sooner rather than later."
dialogues.text: "I would have given up sooner rather than later."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「だから、あの勝負は環の勝ちだ」
dialogues.en: "So, we can count that as a victory for you."
dialogues.text: "So, we can count that as a victory for you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「俺の負けさ」
dialogues.en: "I would've lost, after all."
dialogues.text: "I would've lost, after all."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「本当ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、だから、環とはデートだな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. I'd go on a date with you."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. I'd go on a date with you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「賞品は、デートでいいんだよな？」
dialogues.en: "That is fine as your prize, right?"
dialogues.text: "That is fine as your prize, right?"

dialogues.jp: 負けたクセになんだかエラそうだな、俺。
dialogues.en: It really seems more like a win for me.
dialogues.text: It really seems more like a win for me.

dialogues.jp:
浮かべた笑みは、俺がこれまでに見たどんな笑
顔よりもステキだった。
dialogues.en: The smile returned to her face, a wonderful and bright one.
dialogues.text: The smile returned to her face, a wonderful and bright one.

dialogues.jp: こんな笑顔、俺は見たことが無い。
dialogues.en: I'd not seen such a beautiful smile before.
dialogues.text: I'd not seen such a beautiful smile before.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、決まりな」
dialogues.en: "It's decided, then."
dialogues.text: "It's decided, then."

dialogues.jp:
俺達は、屋上の風に吹かれながら、デートの約
束を交わした。
dialogues.en:
At the rooftop, the wind blowing around us, we exchanged
promises to go on a date.
dialogues.text:
At the rooftop, the wind blowing around us, we exchanged
promises to go on a date.

dialogues.jp: 二人を包む風が、すごく心地よかった……。
dialogues.en: The feeling of us surrounded by the wind... so pleasant.
dialogues.text: The feeling of us surrounded by the wind... so pleasant.

dialogues.jp: ◆お汁粉勝負◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sweet Red-bean Drink Battle?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sweet Red-bean Drink Battle?◆

dialogues.jp:
環と卒業パーティーを一緒に回っていると、ふ
と環がお汁粉大会の張り紙を目にする。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki and I were looking around the graduation party, when
Tamaki happened upon a flyer for a sweet red-bean drink
competition.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki and I were looking around the graduation party, when
Tamaki happened upon a flyer for a sweet red-bean drink
competition.

dialogues.jp:
お汁粉大会で環が勝ったら、俺にデートしてほ
しいと言ってきた。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki said that if she won, she wanted to go on a date with
me.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki said that if she won, she wanted to go on a date with
me.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、その途中、環はことりの危険を予知し、
勝負を放棄する。
dialogues.en:
But, during the battle, Tamaki foresaw danger happening to
Kotori, and abandoned the competition.
dialogues.text:
But, during the battle, Tamaki foresaw danger happening to
Kotori, and abandoned the competition.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、環のいうとおり、ミスコン会場へ突っ走
り、間一髪でことりを救うのだった。
dialogues.en:
Following Tamaki's words, I rushed to the beauty contest
venue, and just made it in time to save Kotori.
dialogues.text:
Following Tamaki's words, I rushed to the beauty contest
venue, and just made it in time to save Kotori.

dialogues.jp: 体育館を抜け出し、環と屋上へと逃げ込む俺達。
dialogues.en:
Eventually, we escaped from the gym, and managed to find our
way to the rooftop.
dialogues.text:
Eventually, we escaped from the gym, and managed to find our
way to the rooftop.

dialogues.jp:
すると、環が暗い表情で、予知能力がばれてし
まったと言う。俺は、もし環を悪く言うものが
いたら、俺が守ると伝える。
dialogues.en:
There, Tamaki was down, having her power exposed. I promised
to protect her from whatever gossip would occur.
dialogues.text:
There, Tamaki was down, having her power exposed. I promised
to protect her from whatever gossip would occur.

dialogues.jp:
環は、実はそのことよりも、デートが無くなっ
たことがガッカリしている様子だった。
dialogues.en:
In truth though, she was more disappointed about losing her
chance at a date with me.
dialogues.text:
In truth though, she was more disappointed about losing her
chance at a date with me.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、お汁粉大会は既にギブアップしていたと
環に伝え、環をデートに誘った。
dialogues.en:
I let Tamaki know that I was about to give up on the
competition anyway, and asked her out on a date.
dialogues.text:
I let Tamaki know that I was about to give up on the
competition anyway, and asked her out on a date.
